verdict.rationale: Vendor docs say Fin "takes action to update external systems." Procedures handle multi-step queries involving third-party systems, and Data Connectors (API or MCP) ship ready-made templates for Stripe and Shopify, so real API actions such as order or billing changes are plausibly supported. However, nothing in the pack describes per-action scoped authentication, and refunds and subscription updates are only implied by the Stripe/Shopify templates. missing for 10: documented per-action scoped auth/credential model, explicit refund/order/subscription action examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of actions working in production.
